title: Gateway accepts the SMS; no delivery receipt ever arrives
summary: A walk-in critical result is sent by SMS. The provider accepts the message and returns a message id, then nothing: no delivery receipt, no failure, no acknowledgment. A dashboard that reads 'accepted' as 'delivered' turns green and the case looks done. The system must keep the case at transport acceptance, never record delivery or communication, and escalate to a person when the acknowledgment does not come.

initial_result.critical_flag_source: Separate authorised laboratory critical-result process (not ResultRelay)

steps.summary: Laboratory finalizes synthetic result revision 1, already flagged critical by a separate authorised process
ResultRelay decides whether to release the communication
No delivery receipt and no acknowledgment after 45 minutes: ResultRelay reconciles the accepted attempt against the provider ledger
65 minutes after acceptance (configured acknowledgment window: 60): ResultRelay decides between waiting, a retry, a fallback channel or escalation to a person

research_questions: Which instrument assigns responsibility for a transactional clinical message lost after gateway acceptance (gap GR-15)?
Does a telecom delivery receipt satisfy the DHA ST-28 §11.1.3 communication record?
